security_audit.summary: AI review found the static alerts are false positives caused by Markdown code fences, LaTeX examples, poster design terminology, sample QR URLs, and a local PDF review script. No prompt injection or intent-level malicious behavior was found.

content.value_statement: Research posters are hard to size, structure, and polish for conferences. This skill provides LaTeX templates, design guidance, and PDF review steps for print-ready posters.
actual_capabilities: Compare beamerposter, tikzposter, and baposter for specific poster needs.
Generate poster layouts with titles, authors, sections, figures, QR code areas, and acknowledgments.
Recommend standard A0, A1, and 36 by 48 inch sizing choices.
Guide typography, color contrast, spacing, and visual hierarchy decisions.
Use the included checklist and review script to inspect PDF size, fonts, images, and page count.
limitations: Users must supply accurate research content, images, logos, and citations.
Conference rules and institutional brand requirements still need manual verification.
Final print color, paper quality, and readability require physical proofing.
The review script depends on local PDF utilities such as pdfinfo, pdffonts, and pdfimages.

use_cases.title: Conference Poster From Draft
use_cases.description: Turn a paper abstract and figure list into a structured LaTeX poster plan.

use_cases.title: Reusable Lab Poster Template
use_cases.description: Create a consistent poster template with shared colors, sections, spacing, and logo placement.

use_cases.title: Final PDF Quality Review
use_cases.description: Check poster size, fonts, images, readability, and print readiness before submission.

prompt_templates.title: Start A Poster
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a LaTeX research poster plan from this abstract. Ask for missing conference size, orientation, author, and figure details before drafting.

prompt_templates.title: Convert Paper To Poster
prompt_templates.prompt: Convert these paper sections into a concise conference poster. Keep the text under 800 words and suggest where each figure should appear.

prompt_templates.title: Choose A Poster Package
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare beamerposter, tikzposter, and baposter for my poster requirements. Recommend one package and explain the layout tradeoffs.

prompt_templates.title: Review Print Readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my poster PDF workflow for print readiness. Check page size, font embedding, image quality, accessibility, and final proofing steps.

output_examples.input: I need an A0 portrait poster for a biology conference with three main figures.
output: Recommended a three-column beamerposter layout with a wide title header.
Mapped introduction, methods, results, conclusions, references, and QR code sections.
Suggested figure sizes, caption placement, and typography targets for distance reading.

output_examples.input: My draft poster has too much text and small charts.
output_examples.output: A revision plan that reduces paragraph text, enlarges the key results, groups supporting details, and prioritizes visual hierarchy.

output_examples.input: I have a finished PDF and need to check whether it is ready for printing.
output_examples.output: A checklist covering page dimensions, page count, embedded fonts, image resolution, color contrast, QR codes, and reduced-scale proofing.

best_practices: Start with conference dimensions and orientation before selecting a template.
Keep text concise and reserve large areas for figures, charts, and visual summaries.
Review the final PDF at full size, then run a reduced-scale print test.
anti_patterns: Using small body text or dense paragraphs that cannot be read from normal poster distance.
Adding figures without checking resolution, captions, and color contrast.
Sending the first compiled PDF to print without checking page size, fonts, and crop boundaries.

faq.question: Which LaTeX poster package should I choose?
faq.answer: Use beamerposter for traditional academic posters, tikzposter for modern visual layouts, and baposter for structured multi-column designs.

faq.question: Can it turn a paper draft into a poster?
faq.answer: Yes. It can condense sections, propose a visual layout, and help prioritize key results for poster viewing.

faq.question: Does it compile the poster automatically?
faq.answer: It can provide compilation commands and review steps, but LaTeX tools must be installed in the local environment.

faq.question: Can it help with accessibility?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes guidance for readable font sizes, high contrast, color-blind friendly palettes, and clear visual hierarchy.

faq.question: Does it include print-quality checks?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes a checklist and a helper script for page size, page count, font, image, and file size checks.

faq.question: Can I use institutional branding?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide approved colors, logos, and spacing rules so the poster can match institutional requirements.
